display.purpose: Page-level h1/h2 on admin and list screens.

label.purpose: Small uppercase section labels and table column headers.

mono.purpose: Every quantitative readout: hours, percentages, IDs, timestamps, counts, the pit-board clock.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Light ambient lift on cards, tables, the skip-link, and the kiosk shell (dark-mode value uses a heavier black alpha).

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Heavier lift for the modal card, which stacks above a dimmed backdrop.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition for background-color/border-color/color state changes on buttons and inputs.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: Live status-dot pulse in the status strip; disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: inherit; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4375rem; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #e01926; border-color: #e01926; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b4131d; border-color: #b4131d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e01926; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default action button; hovers to the surface-2 tone.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: inherit; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4375rem; border-radius: 9px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; border: 1px solid #e5e0d9; background: #ffffff; color: #1b1719; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fbf9f6; border-color: #55636e; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard raised surface with a card header.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e0d9; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,16,14,0.04), 0 6px 20px -10px rgba(20,16,14,0.14); padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 16px; margin: -1.25rem -1.25rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e0d9; } .ds-card-head h3 { font-weight: 750; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; margin: 0; } .ds-count { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #6e6863; background: #eaedef; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Standard text field with the app-wide red focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #6e6863; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e0d9; background: #ffffff; color: #1b1719; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e01926; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Fixed four-color attendance-status vocabulary; also used for role/admin/on-off pills.
components.html: PresentExcusedOptionalAbsent
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-pill-present { background: #1f9d57; color: #ffffff; } .ds-pill-excused { background: #2c6be6; color: #ffffff; } .ds-pill-optional { background: #6b7079; color: #ffffff; } .ds-pill-absent { background: #d67a22; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Pit Board Row
components.description: The system's signature component: index, name, and a live mono clock-in duration with a pulsing present-colored dot.
components.css: .ds-pit-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e0d9; } .ds-idx { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #6e6863; } .ds-nm { font-weight: 650; font-size: 15.5px; } .ds-clock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1b1719; } .ds-live-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1f9d57; }

components.name: Stat Block
components.description: Big mono instrument-reading number with an optional goal-progress bar.
components.css: .ds-stat { padding: 16px; } .ds-stat-num { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 750; font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-stat-num small { font-size: 18px; color: #6e6863; font-weight: 650; } .ds-stat-bar { height: 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: #eaedef; margin-top: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-stat-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: #e01926; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Team Hub reads like the instrument panel on a robotics team's shop floor, not a generic SaaS dashboard. Warm-neutral "shop paper" surfaces hold the page; Red Alert red is the single loud signal reserved for brand and primary action; a cool steel secondary handles quieter structural UI (badges, counts, borders-on-hover); and every number that matters — hours, percentages, IDs, timestamps, live clock-in durations — renders in a monospace, tabular-nums readout, so it feels measured rather than typeset. The kiosk (/kiosk) pushes this furthest: it's committed dark regardless of theme, because it's an always-on shop tablet, not a themed page a person configures.

The system is functional first: dense admin tables, role-gated CRUD, and status pills carry more of the visual weight than decoration does. Personality lives in specific, repeated details — the hazard stripe, the pit board, the live pulsing status dot — not in broad ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral paper canvas with a single loud red accent, used sparingly and consistently for brand + primary action.
Mono, tabular-numeric readouts for every quantitative value (hours, counts, IDs, durations).
Mostly flat surfaces with tonal layering (canvas → surface → surface-2) for depth; shadow is a light ambient touch, not a structural signal.
The kiosk is intentionally always-dark — a shop-floor instrument, not a themed screen.
Full light/dark/system theming via a data-theme attribute, with an inline pre-paint script to avoid a flash of the wrong theme.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is brand and primary-action only — it never appears as a generic accent, decorative color, or a fifth attendance status. If something needs emphasis that isn't "do this now," reach for steel or a status color, not red.

rules.name: The Mono-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any value the user reads as a measurement — hours, percentages, counts, IDs, durations, timestamps — renders in the mono font with tabular-nums, never the body or display font.

rules.name: The Instrument Face Rule
rules.body: Mono is a distinct visual register, not a stylistic variant of body text — it signals "this is data," so it never carries prose, labels, or button text.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layering Rule
rules.body: Reach for the next canvas/surface/surface-2 step before reaching for a heavier shadow. Shadow is ambient texture on raised surfaces, not the primary way this system expresses "this is above that."

dos: Do keep red to brand + the single primary action per view (The One Red Rule).
Do render every quantitative value — hours, percentages, IDs, durations, timestamps — in the mono font with tabular-nums (The Mono-Numbers Rule).
Do reach for the next canvas/surface/surface-2 tonal step before adding a heavier shadow.
Do keep kiosk touch targets large and the kiosk dark regardless of theme.
Do give every interactive control a visible :focus-visible outline (inherited from the global rule) and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't introduce a second loud accent color alongside red; use steel or a status color.
Don't add shadow as a state-change signal (hover/active elevation) — this system's shadow is ambient, not structural.
Don't style numeric readouts in the body or display font — that's reserved for the mono face.
Don't theme the kiosk to follow light/dark — it's fixed dark by design.
Don't invent a fifth attendance-status color; present/excused/optional/absent is a closed, semantically fixed set.
